arguments.rule_content:
title: Suspicious Kerberoasting Activity - Service Account Targeting
logsource:
  category: authentication
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4769
    ServicePrincipalName: '*svc_sql_prod* or *svc_exchange_admin* or *svc_sccm*'
    TicketEncryption: '0x17' # RC4-HMAC
  condition: selection
level: high
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1558/003/
description: Detects Kerberoasting attempts against high-value service accounts using RC4 encryption downgrade.
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity (rare)
author: SOC Team

rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Decoded {
    meta:
        description = "Detects in-memory presence of Cobalt Strike beacon via decoded artifacts"
        author = "SOC Team"
        maltype = "Backdoor"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 62 65 61 63 6F 6E 5F 63 6F 6E 66 69 67 } // "beacon_config" string
        $c2_https_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" fullword ascii
        $user_agent = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 6.1; WOW64; Trident/7.0; rv:11.0) like Gecko" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}

arguments.summary: A compromised host (WS-FIN-042, IP 10.0.5.42) was identified exhibiting Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior to a known-malicious external IP (198.51.100.23). The initial compromise occurred via a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell execution, leading to lateral movement attempts within the 10.0.5.0/24 subnet. The user CORP\jsmith's account was compromised, and host-based artifacts indicate DLL sideloading via rundll32.exe and host file modification. Containment and eradication actions have been initiated.
